content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the document, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer's freedom to hire.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Customer anywhere. Targeted searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "employee", and "personnel", plus review of the General (§ 30), Customer Responsibilities (§ 12), Confidentiality (§ 16), and Compliance (§ 26) sections, return no restrictive covenant binding Customer as to Vendor personnel. § 12.3 goes further and affirmatively preserves Customer's right to hire any person who responds to general recruitment and records that Customer has given no no-hire commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is proposed; the fallback mutual/12-month/carve-out construct is not needed.
